reason: This is a cross-cutting transaction-semantics change, not a local fix: adding `WithReturnCommitTS` appears to modify commit/txn behavior and propagates through core `kv`/`store/driver/txn` layers into `executor` write/read paths, table/index/partition code, plus server/session-adjacent surfaces. That combination has clear high-blast-radius risk for transaction correctness, commit visibility, and storage/runtime behavior, so it is worth a focused Blocker/High review.
